metadata.preview:
---
import Layout from '../layouts/Layout.astro';
import PorscheHeader from '../components/PorscheHeader.vue';
import PorscheHero from '../components/PorscheHero.vue';
import PorscheServiceCard from '../components/PorscheServiceCard.vue';
---

<Layout title="Porsche Design System Demo - DeGoogle Guide">
  <PorscheHeader client:load />
  <PorscheHero client:load />

  <section class="py-12">
    <div class="container mx-auto">
      <p-heading tag="h2" size="large" class="mb-8 text-center">Why De-Google?</p-heading>
      <div class="grid md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        <PorscheServiceCard
          title="Privacy Concerns"
          description="Google tracks your every move across services. De-Googling helps protect your personal data."
          icon="🔒"
          client:load
